'''Ba'Ols''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Tarasin]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Tarasin]], Ba'Ols [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] at the [[Almas Academy]], one of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order's]] more experimental [[Jedi academy|academies]]. Stationed on [[Almas]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], Padawan Ba'Ols was dispatched to the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Uffel]] to defend a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] production facility when [[LN-73]] and his band of saboteurs attempted to seize it.<ref name="SU" />
